title: Lovskii: Bringing music to life on his recent Track, "NOTme"
htmlContent:
Talented Northern Irish artist, Lovskii is a rapper and songwriter with a penchant for writing infectious tunes and relatable narratives. The 17 years old rapper has mainly revolved around cloud rap, although he likes to go into different genres. Lovskii gives you exciting music for every second of the new song "NOTme."

Lovskii's "NOTme" is that fun, stand-out music that makes you appreciate art and creativity. It brings its wave to engulf the listener as he lets his stand-out approach make a significant statement for a promising artist that's worth looking out for.
